summary.status: PROPOSAL ONLY - NOT APPROVED OR INSTALLED
summary.design_note: 162 proposed species across 69 families. Steel/Fire echidna selected; eight final-stage dragons redesigned from distinct myth traditions; every species requires eyes and a face. Final catalogue approval and production sprite checks remain pending.

animal_diversity.note: Real anatomy informs these fantasy creatures; powers and elemental structures are invented.

summary.type_scope_note: All 18 individual types are already represented. Zero additions are required for basic type presence. These expansion options improve archetype balance; the full option also fills 68 missing dual-type combinations.
summary.boxer_decision: Tusskip -> Ruffellow; athletic former middle design retained as final, Palabrawl removed.
summary.supplemental_request_note: Echidna alternatives require cute-to-threatening evolution. Tardigrade remains Geodot to Opalith, Rock/Fairy.
summary.art_completion_definition: Concept review sheets cover every proposed species slot. This does not mean approved or production-ready battle/walking sprites.
summary.echidna_selection: Steel/Fire selected: Pricklet > Cinderlance > Ferriferno. Steel/Fighting is archived and excluded from the current approval reference.
summary.art_revision: Steel/Fire echidna selected; eight myth-inspired dragon finals and twelve face corrections. Concept artwork only; production sprite QA pending.

families.niche: A modest fire companion whose heat is stored in fur, not an exposed flame.
families.evolution_features: Long low quilt-plated torso, a broad angular shoulder cape of fur and a high tail arch with three separated glowing coil rings; narrow confident face and small ears. No huge juvenile ear fan.

families.niche: Gentle rain-mantle support rather than another fish or armoured aquatic.
families.evolution_features: Long rain-coated body, tall poised legs, a dramatic clear water mantle spread into two broad shoulder sails and a single long tail surrounded by three streaming water ribbons; sleek masked face.

families.niche: Rhythm and static sensing, distinct from the existing Electric ridge runner.
families.evolution_features: Exceptionally long powerful hindlegs, tall narrow receiver ears with forked copper tips, a high dark shoulder collar and three amber counterweight pods suspended along one sweeping pendulum tail.

families.niche: Soft insulation and cold storage, avoiding another horned Ice beast.
families.evolution_features: Stocky noble alpine guardian with short rounded ears, a broad ice-beard chest ruff and TWO enormous swept-back crystalline shoulder fans; layered diamond frost plates down the flanks and a tiny tail. No rabbit ears.

families.niche: A grounded scrappy ordinary animal fighter, without military costume.
families.evolution_features: Retain Ruffellow's current middle-form face, swept russet quiff, athletic upright proportions, burgundy padded forepaws and cream chest. Add a flat dark paddle tail and subtle paired chisel incisors to establish beaver inspiration. This is the final form; no bulky third stage.

families.niche: Ink-warning anatomy and controlled venom, rather than a generic sludge blob.
families.habitat: Tannery back lanes and reed drains
families.evolution_features: Long low prowling body, a wide spiked violet venom collar behind the narrow head, three long toxin whiskers on each side of the snout, large shovel foreclaws and a segmented bare tail arch. Keep the pointed flexible snout.

families.niche: A clay-backed digger with tactile plate texture, not another mole.
families.evolution_features: Three enormous golden quill fans along the spine, terracotta shovel shoulder plates, a long narrow probing muzzle and a compact four-legged stone-burrow chassis. Crown and flank quills form a sharp triangular silhouette.

families.niche: Textile mimicry and precise insect anatomy, avoiding the existing lace-wing fairy moth.
families.evolution_features: A long S-curved velvet body, many short soft legs, TWO large spiral oral silk nozzles, a wide indigo scalloped collar and a row of tall rounded silk-spool dorsal lobes. No wings or insect armour.

families.niche: An organic stone-backed hyrax rather than a complete rock golem.
families.habitat: Old road milestones and quarry shelves
families.evolution_features: Low wide body with a stepped mesa of riverstone plates rising over the back, broad stone-capped cheek guards, a blunt small-eared face and four short pillar feet. The back outline forms three clear terraces.

families.niche: Folklore memory embodied as a warm mammal-dragon, without written text on its body.
families.evolution_features: A massive low-slung tuatara-derived dragon inspired by reptilian taniwha forms. Broad crocodilian jaw, two fierce copper slit-pupilled eyes, huge splayed webbed foreclaws, powerful four-legged shoulders, thick armour scales and three jagged ink-blue dorsal ridge sails. A heavy ring-plated tail coils around its stance. Parchment jaw and copper-edged scale frills retain the family colours. Head is broad and unmistakably draconic with an exposed tooth-lined mouth, not a small ordinary lizard. Rugged ecology-driven hunting-beast design; no human costume or sacred carving motifs.

mythological_inspiration.name: Taniwha
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Stealthy food-retrieval ecology rather than another raven or sinister canine.
families.evolution_features: Large high-shouldered shaggy body, a pale dramatic moustache fan, a midnight crescent back ruff and one thick prehensile tail folded into a high hook with a silver tip; long forelegs and moon-marked face.

families.niche: Small metal-eating mammal with expressive organic eyes, not a mechanical robot.
families.evolution_features: Long sleek copper-brown body, overlapping pewter ladder plates following flank stripes, a tall metallic brush-tail fan, hooked digging foreclaws and a very long coiled copper tongue. Narrow numbat muzzle remains visible.

families.niche: A credible hot-cold amphibian whose contrasting temperatures are anatomically separated.
families.evolution_features: Extremely long pale serpentine salamander body with four tiny legs, TWO huge branching thermal gill fans, one ice-cyan and one hot coral, and a serrated dual-colour dorsal ridge. Nearly hidden eyes; no dragon limbs. Facial revision: Olm faces need clearly readable paired dark eyes and a small salamander mouth; no nearly hidden or absent eyes. Preserve thermal branching gills.

families.niche: Footwork-based fiery marsupial, avoiding a human martial artist silhouette.
families.evolution_features: Very tall elegant kicking legs with flared natural heat guards, a large swept-back fan of black-and-coral head quills, broad layered shoulder plumage and a blade-like long tail; athletic raptor posture, no human arms.

families.niche: Incense-serpent anatomy and toxic smoke, without a carried object.
families.evolution_features: Huge angular furnace-like abdomen with paired tall flared organic spray valves, a copper horned thorax collar, six braced legs and two large dark shield elytra. Distinct front-small rear-large beetle silhouette.

families.niche: A wing-membrane fire glider rather than another phoenix.
families.evolution_features: Huge long angular wings, a blazing spherical throat pouch framed by golden feather rays, long forked banner tail and a slim hooked-bill head; sun-herald silhouette, no generic phoenix crest.

families.niche: Fired-clay ecology, keeping the ceramic plates visibly distinct from living flesh.
families.evolution_features: Broad squat lizard, two great obsidian neck shields beside the false-head knob, large swept conical horns, visible brick-red lava channels and a thick tail with a flattened spiked hammer tip.

families.niche: A heat-glass royal reptile with restraint and no legendary status.
families.evolution_features: A threatening Fafnir-inspired wingless hoard wyrm with a long muscular gecko-derived body, four massive copper gripping claws, a low armoured chest and an enormous three-tier jagged leaf-blade tail. Garnet volcanic scales and antique-gold armour plates grow as natural anatomy. Heavy swept crown horns, angular jaw, two glowing gold slit-pupilled eyes and exposed fangs create a clear predatory dragon face. Molten seams and smoky tail edges show Fire typing. Keep the leaf-tailed motif, but make the adult a colossal grounded dragon rather than an enlarged gecko.

mythological_inspiration.name: Fafnir
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Cute toxin-bearing amphibian with readable defensive anatomy.
families.evolution_features: Eight arms with four short shielding arms and four long heavy ribbon arms, a broad scalloped arm web, a pointed mantle crown and bright cobalt rings surrounding translucent violet venom bulbs along the arms.

families.niche: True flying-fish silhouette, avoiding another aquatic bird.
families.evolution_features: Long silver body with TWO huge blade-sail pectoral fins plus TWO smaller rear fin sails, tall cerulean dorsal rudder and forked streaming tail surrounded by a thin water-ring wake. No feathers or feet.

families.niche: Air-reservoir insect with oar movement rather than a crab.
families.evolution_features: A layered five-ridge blue shield carapace, a crown of pearl bubble lenses along the side margins, many small swimming limbs beneath, three dorsal eye marks and two very long ribbonlike tail filaments.

families.niche: Leafy marine dragon with a vertical floating pose rather than a crocodile.
families.evolution_features: An imposing Japanese sea-dragon-inspired marine leviathan, retaining leafy sea-dragon origins in coral antler horns, jade blade-like fronds and a deep-teal elongated serpentine body. Broad armoured dragon head with two luminous amber eyes, long whisker fins and an open fanged jaw. Four short powerful three-clawed swimming limbs develop in the final evolution; long ribbon tail, coral throat reservoir plates and enormous layered jade fin racks create a dramatic coiled silhouette. No wings. Natural coral and scale armour; noble but dangerous, not a delicate seahorse.

mythological_inspiration.name: Japanese sea dragon traditions
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Light-hiding deepwater ecology, avoiding a generic shark.
families.evolution_features: Broad dark eight-armed cloak fully opened into a scalloped star silhouette, paired long mantle fins, a pointed velvet mantle and pale cyan lure lights at each web tip; eye is bright and watchful, not a generic octopus.

families.niche: A magical sea slug with shell iridescence, no human mermaid form.
families.evolution_features: An elongated translucent opal body, two enormous scalloped wing lobes spread into a butterflylike silhouette, a lavender internal core and three small pearl light orbs forming a halo; no human limbs or face. Facial revision: Sea angels need a friendly compact face with two large pearl-dark eyes and a small curved mouth on the front of the head, beneath the translucent crown. Do not confuse body glow with eyes.

families.niche: Plant capacitance, separating it from animal Electric designs.
families.evolution_features: A curved branching stalk with THREE large green siphon bulbs, copper coiled conducting tendrils, broad leafy animal-sac skirts and a circular lemon current crown; floats on an anchoring root pad rather than invented feet. Facial revision: Sea tulip tunicates need a permanent front-facing facial disc on the central body, two amber eyes and a small expressive mouth. Siphon openings remain botanical structures, not substitutes for a face.

families.niche: Frost-resonance insect whose pulse comes from wings rather than a battery body.
families.evolution_features: Large pale translucent fish, a tall crown of forked dorsal conductor rays and four broad layered ice-edged fin fans, amber electrical channels visible through the body; broad wedge head rather than tiny juvenile head.

families.niche: Electrical fungal signalling and toxins, with no humanoid mushroom face.
families.evolution_features: Long heavily segmented larva with a forked luminous tail nozzle, tall violet head crest, hooked jaw shields and a fan of chartreuse toxin lantern lobes along the abdomen. Six small forelegs, no adult beetle wings.

families.niche: Insulated desert reptile, rather than another ground rodent.
families.evolution_features: Broad ground-breaking chassis, two huge copper digging forepaws shaped into three-pronged coil spades, a large amber star nose rosette and ridged triangular shoulder plates. Nose and forepaws dominate the silhouette. Facial revision: Star-nosed moles need two clear amber eyes on the brow ABOVE the radial star nose, separated by a visible muzzle bridge. The star must not obscure the eyes.

families.niche: Airborne ray creature with a physical body and stable wing anatomy.
families.evolution_features: Wide swept kite-shaped gliding membrane connecting neck, four limbs and tail, dark navy scalloped flight edges, yellow branching conductor veins and a high swept brow crest. Flat gliding stance, not a squirrel with wings.

families.niche: Readable electrical neural lattice without an exposed brain.
families.evolution_features: Large transparent head dome containing two upward green tube eyes and a gold toroidal thought halo, long dark fish body, tall prism dorsal sail and broad lateral blade fins. Front nostril marks are not eyes.

families.niche: Quiet blackout ecology rather than a snarling electric cat.
families.evolution_features: Tall lanky nocturnal primate stance, long shaggy tail arched into a lightning loop, very large tufted ears, high dark chest ruff and one extremely thin extended tapping finger per hand surrounded by forked yellow sparks.

families.niche: Botanical foresight presented as alert herbivore behaviour.
families.evolution_features: Tall elegant antelope, huge ringed branching oracle horns, mossy clover shoulder mane and a large hanging nose glowing as a lavender pollen lantern. Four slim legs, pale flanks and a short tail.

families.niche: Seed-case engineer rather than a flower moth.
families.evolution_features: Six legs with deep jagged leaf lobes, two broad shieldlike veined leaf wings spread into a layered shoulder canopy, tall twig antennae and a gold silk spindle collar. Flat leaf-shaped body remains visible.

families.niche: A living lichen mosaic on organic stone armour.
families.evolution_features: Wide low shell carrying three great mossy granite temple ridges, a very broad triangular fringed head, long rust neck tassels and flat stony hind buttresses. Short snorkel nose, no smooth tortoise head. Facial revision: Mata mata turtles need an exposed reptile head projecting beyond the moss/stone canopy, two bright amber eyes and a clear broad smiling or stern jawline. Armour must not hide the face.

families.niche: Tree-care dragon with flexible wood anatomy, distinct from the sea dragon.
families.evolution_features: A Ladon-inspired orchard guardian dragon descended from an armadillo girdled lizard. THREE fully formed serpent necks emerge from one broad four-legged bark-armoured body; each head has two emerald eyes, a distinct jaw and visible fangs. The centre head is larger and dominant. Massive emerald thorn-blade collar, interlocking brown bark scales, berry-red throat markings and a long coiled spiny tail preserve the family. Broad grasping foreclaws and low territorial posture. This three-headed adaptation borrows the many-headed guardian motif; the anatomy is an original fantasy design.

mythological_inspiration.name: Ladon
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Defensive berry camouflage rather than predatory plant jaws.
families.evolution_features: Tall long-necked forest herald, two long thorn-fork ossicones, a wide collar of dark leaves and blackberry clusters, long elegant chestnut body and strongly striped cream-and-black legs and hindquarters.

families.niche: Burrowing seal anatomy, not another ice mole.
families.evolution_features: Low glacial plough body with a high ridged pink-and-cyan dorsal shield, two great hooked ice digging claws, pale silk underside and a broad frosted shoulder collar. Compact head tucked under the shield.

families.niche: Aurora membrane glider with four readable limbs.
families.evolution_features: Regal dark bird with a wide layered white frost mantle, iridescent pointed head crown and TWO enormous white ribbon tail feathers curled into a sweeping aurora arch. No extra tail feathers.

families.niche: Memory held in a glassy body without humanoid fortune-teller imagery.
families.evolution_features: Tall faceted translucent lavender body with eight sharply defined cyan comb rails bowed outward like a crystal cage, a suspended mirrorlike central core and two long delicate streaming tentacles. No legs. Facial revision: Comb jellies need two bright dark-violet eyes with white highlights and a small expressive mouth on a defined smooth facial patch near the lower front of the central bell; keep transparent comb-rib anatomy.

families.niche: Silk insulation expressed as a cold-adapted crawler, not another moth.
families.evolution_features: High crescent ice-armoured abdomen, a huge two-pronged folded jumping fork visible behind, two caliperlike icy antennae and six short braced legs; white wool tufts framed by black-and-mint plates.

families.niche: Root-shaped winter spirit, distinct from shrouded lantern ghosts.
families.evolution_features: Five main arms branching repeatedly into a vast circular icy crown cage, small dark central disc suspended inside, ghost-white branching tips carrying blue snow pearls; no humanoid hands or plant trunk. Facial revision: Basket stars need an unmistakable face on the central disc, two pale cyan eyes with dark pupils and an expressive mouth below. Arms remain branching star limbs, no mammal head.

families.niche: Animal palm-control fighter without clothing or human religious symbols.
families.evolution_features: High raised armoured front body, TWO enormous asymmetric spiral striking clubs held forward, large faceted stalked eyes, a lavender sensory crest and a wide layered gold tail fan. Crustacean body, no human fists.

families.niche: Grappling mechanics built around insect pincers, rather than another mantis blade.
families.evolution_features: Wide flat eight-legged arachnid with two enormous asymmetric burgundy shield pedipalps, long copper locking claw tips and an angular plated head. Absolutely no tail or stinger.

families.niche: Stone-hook wrestling goat, with a practical environmental role.
families.evolution_features: Tall cliff-carrying land crab, a great granite outcrop shell, ONE enormous ochre boulder claw and one narrow chisel claw, long heavy walking legs and a broad armoured abdomen. No goat features.

families.niche: Technical reptile grappler, avoiding humanoid dragon-boxer shapes.
families.evolution_features: A formidable shoebill-cockatrice dragon with two huge muscular bird hindlegs, broad reptilian chest armour, copper hooked talons and massive olive feather-and-scale wing forelimbs. Retain the unmistakable broad shoe-shaped bill, now edged by hard angular keratin ridges; two intense red eyes, horned brow and a tall copper-red crown make a clear threatening face. A long plated serpentine tail and draconic neck mantle replace the ordinary bird silhouette. Original animalistic wyvern posture with powerful kicking stance, no human arms or costume.

mythological_inspiration.name: Cockatrice and basilisk bestiary traditions
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Iron-backed burrow rescuer rather than a knight in armour.
families.evolution_features: Very tall flightless warbird with a large crescent steel casque, flared blue neck armour feathers, red bannerlike wattles, black layered shoulder plumage and huge hooked ivory inner toe talons.

families.niche: Clay-working toxin amphibian with a useful ecology.
families.evolution_features: Long legless shale-ringed amphibian coiled high, a broad toxin crystal crown behind the blunt head, two tiny sensory snout openings and plum seams through large annular body ridges. No snake scales or arms.

families.niche: Pattern hypnosis embodied in a jelly creature, not a humanoid magician.
families.evolution_features: Long iridescent segmented worm reared into a broad S-curve, two enormous opposing hinged jaw blades, a fan crown of long turquoise feelers and violet featherlike bristle bundles along both sides. No humanoid face. Facial revision: Bobbit worms need two large bright green eyes on an upper forehead above the jaws, a defined brow and recognisable mouth. Keep segmented worm and mouth/antennae design, no generic cat face.

families.niche: A remembered toxic ecosystem, distinct from a skull-shaped ghost.
families.evolution_features: A long branching colony of at least seven varied translucent bell modules, a tall smoky head float, amber memory organs inside each bell and many fine trailing spectral tentacles. No single octopus mantle. Facial revision: Siphonophores need two gold pupil-bearing eyes and a curved mouth on the leading bell-shaped zooid as a stable main face. Remaining glowing zooids are secondary structures, no detached faces.

families.niche: Bitter-fruit specialist with controlled poison and stealth.
families.evolution_features: Wide low ambush stance with eight long angular legs, greatly extended front legs, two large watchful front eyes, dark violet armour hairs and jagged pale camouflage tufts forming a broken shoulder silhouette.

families.niche: Sealed heavy-metal chemistry, with coherent snail anatomy.
families.evolution_features: Towering conical shell with three armoured dark-violet whorls and silver iron ladder ridges, a very wide muscular foot fan covered in overlapping charcoal scales, violet toxin droplets at the scale edges. Facial revision: Scaly-foot snails need an exposed soft dark-violet head with TWO clearly visible pale gold eyes at the tips of short forward eye stalks and a small mouth underneath. The shell must not cover the face.

families.niche: Ground-skimming ray, distinguished from the high-altitude Electric ray.
families.evolution_features: Elegant desert bird in a broad wing-spread stance, long triangular dusty-blue flight feathers, a layered sand-gold shoulder mantle and a large diamond-pattern water-storing belly feather patch; small bird head.

families.niche: Drainage-engineering mole cricket with accurate six-limb anatomy.
families.evolution_features: Dramatic metamorphosis: mature long-bodied six-legged adult with FOUR large net-veined umber wings, two strong curved clay mandibles and a slender segmented terracotta abdomen. Clearly different from the squat larva.

families.niche: Seed-urn spirit with no human face, text or carried vessel.
families.evolution_features: Very long terracotta ribbon body knotted into a great looping tail, a broad ring of bone-white mouth barbels and teal spectral streams emerging from many side pores; no fins invented as walking feet. Facial revision: Hagfish need two luminous teal pupil-bearing eyes set on a small defined head above the ringed mouth; retain the whisker filaments and coiling legless body. Not just a tooth ring.

families.niche: Nocturnal burrow planning rather than another wolf or mole.
families.evolution_features: Tall lean striped body, a huge jagged clay-and-charcoal dorsal mohawk sweeping over the shoulders, long narrow amber-eyed head, great pointed ears and low armoured shoulder ruffs. Not a generic wolf or cat.

families.niche: Cute earth-and-petal creature with physical clay texture.
families.evolution_features: Tall poised marsupial with enormous petal-shaped cream ears, pink-clay digging foreclaws surrounded by sage vine rings, a leafy chest ruff and a long black-and-white tipped tail curled into a rootlike fan.

families.niche: Four-wing aerial insect focused on precise movement.
families.evolution_features: Huge projecting blue crystal head lantern surrounded by a forked silver sensory crown, SIX legs, two long mottled roof forewings and TWO vivid emerald patterned hindwings spread wide. No damselfly body.

families.niche: Bat-shaped ghost membrane, distinct from a bird or hanging funerary shroud.
families.evolution_features: Tall bark-camouflaged bird with very wide closed gape, large yellow eyes, a broken branchlike head crown and two huge stepped spectral feather shoulder fans, ivory-and-teal ghost markings flowing down the body.

families.niche: Aerodynamic folded-scale dragon with no paper props.
families.evolution_features: A fearsome feathered sky-serpent dragon with pterosaur ancestry: long muscular sky-blue body, elongated predatory head with two bright copper eyes, heavy curved fanged jaw and swept horn crown framed by layered ivory and turquoise plumage. TWO huge forelimb membrane wings have rugged copper wing fingers and a serrated feather fringe; TWO strong hindlegs with hooked claws. A very long serpentine tail terminates in a giant feathered diamond vane. Broad chest, powerful flight musculature and elaborate storm mane; no extra limbs, no costume, no religious regalia.

mythological_inspiration.name: Feathered serpent traditions associated with Quetzalcoatl
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Ant spatial memory made visible in a glass abdomen.
families.evolution_features: Clear metamorphosis: SIX-legged adult with large violet-glass roof wings containing gold windowlike memory cells, a tall forked sensory head crest and long gold antenna filaments. The base is WINGLESS with wax threads.

families.niche: Dream ecology rather than cosmic legendary spectacle.
families.evolution_features: A Bakunawa-inspired eclipse leviathan evolved from the Spanish dancer nudibranch. A huge long coiled lavender body with three enormous midnight-indigo ruffled mantle fins sweeping backwards like living wing sails. Clearly sculpted predatory dragon head with two luminous pearl eyes beneath an indigo brow, a single crescent nasal horn and a broad open fanged mouth. Branching pearl dorsal gill crown and layered ridged neck armour; no walking legs. The mantle remains organic and slug-derived but the final silhouette is a monstrous moon-eating sea serpent rather than a bigger frilled slug.

mythological_inspiration.name: Bakunawa
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Flint-working beetle with visibly biological joints.
families.evolution_features: Very broad flint horseshoe shield built into five angular mineral bastion ridges, large hinged abdominal plate, tiny legs underneath and one very long straight tail spine. No scorpion body.

families.niche: Stone-restoration spirit with no engraved text or human skull.
families.evolution_features: Tall double-curved slate silica lattice tower with three open teal-lit cup chimneys, large windowlike openings, a flowing fan of anchoring threads and bone-white glass crown tips. No humanoid stone limbs. Facial revision: Glass sponges need two large teal pupil-bearing eyes and a clear dark mouth formed on a solid bone-white facial mask integrated into the FRONT of the central silica lattice tower. Windows and glowing chamber cavities are not eyes. Preserve glass-sponge lattice and anchoring threads.

families.niche: Protective obsidian pangolin, allowing a cool Dark design without simple villain coding.
families.evolution_features: Long massive wedge-shaped scale armour with three rows of jagged obsidian blade ridges, huge digging foreclaws, narrow pointed muzzle and a broad powerful tail carrying overlapping triangular plates.

families.niche: Slow resilient special tank; cute microscopic water-bear anatomy grows into a geode guardian.
families.evolution_features: Plump eight-legged guardian with a high rose-opal geode shoulder crown, broad stone brow shield, several large faceted pink dorsal nodules and cream hook claws on four pairs of legs. Round muzzle, no bear ears.

families.niche: Ancestral river-memory dragon without exposed gore.
families.evolution_features: A terrifying Nidhoggr-inspired spectral dragon descended from an oarfish. An extremely long muscular pale-blue ribbon torso forms a dramatic double S; TWO vast torn midnight-purple membrane wings grow from strong shoulders, with TWO hooked foreclaws beneath the chest and no hindlegs. A long dragon skull with two clear icy-blue eyes, a sharp toothed jaw and swept red fin-ray horns. Rootlike bone ridges, ghost-white chest plates and streaming purple fins create a deathly elder-beast silhouette. Preserve the red dorsal fin crown and ribbon tail; threatening draconic face, not an ordinary pretty fish.

mythological_inspiration.name: Nidhoggr
mythological_inspiration.note: Original visual interpretation; invented anatomy and powers are not claims about traditional depictions.

families.niche: Gentle keepsake spirit, avoiding another lantern or cloth-covered ghost.
families.evolution_features: Large opal-lavender mantle, TWO huge ear-like swimming fins spread into a canopy, EIGHT webbed arms forming a broad scalloped umbrella and soft rose pearl lights sheltered under each arm tip. No cloth shroud.

families.niche: Lock-and-latch anatomy on an organic lynx, with no worn armour or keys.
families.evolution_features: Flat charcoal arachnid with TWO enormous silver scythelike grasping pedipalps, SIX angular walking legs and TWO extraordinarily long sensory front legs forming teal tracer loops; armoured brow crown, no tail.

families.niche: Selected Steel/Fire echidna family with cute juvenile and threatening furnace-quilled final form.
families.habitat: Dry scrub banks and iron-rich burrows
families.evolution_features: Threatening furnace echidna with long low muscular body, huge dark steel shoulder mantle, copper shovel claws and three immense swept quill fans with molten-orange cores and a flame corona flowing backwards. Narrow amber eyes and a sharp cream facial blaze.

abilities_text.primary: A damaging move deals 10% more damage if it is a different type from this monster's previous damaging move.
abilities_text.secondary: After it is hit by a damaging move, further damage from that move's type is reduced by 20% until this monster switches out.
abilities_text.hidden: This monster cannot flinch.

species.palette: Warm cream, chestnut, muted ember orange
species.design_niche: A modest fire companion whose heat is stored in fur, not an exposed flame.
species.catalogue_entry: It warms abandoned bedrolls, but scorches them if startled.

species.combat_plan: A flexible four-move choice, with no automatic best answer to every matchup.
species.counterplay: Moderate Speed and bulk; specialists outperform it in their favoured exchanges. Type weaknesses: Water x2, Fighting x2, Ground x2, Rock x2.
species.classification: Ordinary nonlegendary, non-pseudo; no rarity growth bonus proposed

encounter_proposal.habitat: Roadside camp ashes
encounter_proposal.notes: Propose a 6% day encounter share at levels 3-5 on the first road. Only this base form appears here; no early signature or reliable high-power coverage. Rebalance encounter weights after approval.

walking_spec.motion: walk
walking_spec.layout: 2 columns x 4 rows; rows down, left, up, right; columns step A/B
walking_spec.review: Eight authored directional poses alongside one battle portrait
walking_spec.future_target: 64x128 atlas with 32x32 cells, subject to approved art cropping and runtime QA

species.battle_spec: Full body, three-quarter facing left, expressive readable silhouette, existing hand-painted anime creature style; no scenery or text.
species.art_status: REVIEW SHEET AVAILABLE - USER APPROVAL AND PRODUCTION QA PENDING
species.balance_note: These are review proposals. Growth rolls use the existing bounded system; HP gains remain in tens. Evolution must preserve earned growth. Type immunities and coverage require playtesting after approval. Type immunities: Ghost.
species.evolution_design_note: Retain the family animal body plan. Each evolution changes body proportions and elemental structures, rather than only colours. Evolution must add at least two visible structural features and change silhouette, stance or body proportions; scaling and recolouring alone are insufficient.
species.generation_prompt:
Original Abyssals monster family approval sheet, animal inspiration Dormouse, elemental types NORMAL/FIRE. PORTRAIT 1024x1536 transparent PNG. Divide canvas into exactly 3 equal horizontal row bands with NO drawn lines. Evolution stages progress top to bottom in this exact order: Toastuft, Brindlit, Hearthyl. EACH row band contains exactly ONE complete hand-painted anime battle portrait on its LEFT half, facing left, and exactly EIGHT small retro pixel-art overworld poses on its RIGHT half arranged TWO columns by FOUR rows (front/down, left, back/up, right; step A and different step B). Thus the sheet has 3 battle portraits and 24 walking poses in total. Keep every stage completely within its own row. No missing poses, duplicates or additional portraits. All eight sprites within each row must match that row's battle creature and stage. Correct animal appendages and anatomy essential, legless swimmers stay legless. Clean outlines, cel shading, restrained highlights, complete unclipped bodies with generous clear margins. Walking sprites use crisp chunky pixels readable at32x32. Make each evolution visibly different in proportions and elemental structures, with consistent family motifs. Detailed designs:
ROW 1, Toastuft (Base): A cream dormouse with chestnut ears, ember freckles and a curled heat-storing tail. Palette: Warm cream, chestnut, muted ember orange. Movement: walk.
ROW 2, Brindlit (Middle): An adolescent heat-storing dormouse with a clearly elongated slim torso, longer slender legs and a narrow cream muzzle. Chestnut ears are smaller relative to its body than Toastuft. Ember freckles form two neat stripes along its russet flanks. Its tail is an elongated S-shaped double coil rather than Toastuft's round fluffy tail. Compact angular shoulder tufts suggest developing quilt fur; playful but alert. No enormous paws or thick lion mane.. Palette: Warm cream, chestnut, muted ember orange. Movement: walk with alternating anatomical limbs.
ROW 3, Hearthyl (Final): An adult hearth dormouse with a distinctly long low-slung body, short powerful soot-dark feet and a broad russet back made of interlocking diamond-shaped quilt fur patches. Small rounded chestnut ears, a pointed cream muzzle, alert narrow eyes and a long slender tail ending in three glowing ring coils. Leaner body and smaller ears than Toastuft; not simply a larger copy of the baby. No oversized cat paws, no huge fluffy tail, no lion mane.. Palette: Warm cream, chestnut, muted ember orange. Movement: walk with alternating anatomical limbs.
No text, names, lettering, labels, lines, frames, scenery, shadows, fog or background. NO generic cat face on non-cat animals. Transparent background. Polished cute and cool collectible creature game art.

A heavy ring-plated tail coils around its stance. Parchment jaw and copper-edged scale frills retain the family colours. Head is broad and unmistakably draconic with an exposed tooth-lined mouth, not a small ordinary lizard. Rugged ecology-driven hunting-beast design; no human costume or sacred carving motifs.

species.generation_prompt:
Original Abyssals monster family approval sheet, animal inspiration Sea angel, elemental types WATER/FAIRY. PORTRAIT 1024x1536 transparent PNG. Divide canvas into exactly 3 equal horizontal row bands with NO drawn lines. Evolution stages progress top to bottom in this exact order: Pearlup, Nacreel, Opaloria. EACH row band contains exactly ONE complete hand-painted anime battle portrait on its LEFT half, facing left, and exactly EIGHT small retro pixel-art overworld poses on its RIGHT half arranged TWO columns by FOUR rows (front/down, left, back/up, right; step A and different step B). Thus the sheet has 3 battle portraits and 24 walking poses in total. Keep every stage completely within its own row. No missing poses, duplicates or additional portraits. All eight sprites within each row must match that row's battle creature and stage. Correct animal appendages and anatomy essential, legless swimmers stay legless. Clean outlines, cel shading, restrained highlights, complete unclipped bodies with generous clear margins. Walking sprites use crisp chunky pixels readable at32x32. Make each evolution visibly different in proportions and elemental structures, with consistent family motifs. Detailed designs:
ROW 1, Pearlup (Base): A tiny round-bodied juvenile with simplified proportions and only a small trace of its elemental markings. Based on a sea angel: Small translucent tapered body, two broad wing-like swimming lobes and a warm glowing internal core; no human limbs or mermaid face. Fantasy adaptation: Opal swimming lobes refract a warm lavender internal glow. Keep the animal body plan readable; no generic cat face, humanoid armour or unrelated dragon anatomy.. Palette: Opal white, lavender, seafoam. Movement: hover / swim with two distinct fin, arm or body pulses.
ROW 2, Nacreel (Middle): A lean adolescent with a visibly longer torso, clearer appendages and developing elemental structures. Based on a sea angel: Small translucent tapered body, two broad wing-like swimming lobes and a warm glowing internal core; no human limbs or mermaid face. Fantasy adaptation: Opal swimming lobes refract a warm lavender internal glow. Keep the animal body plan readable; no generic cat face, humanoid armour or unrelated dragon anatomy.. Palette: Opal white, lavender, seafoam. Movement: hover / swim with two distinct fin, arm or body pulses.
ROW 3, Opaloria (Final): A mature creature with a strongly recognisable adult silhouette and fully developed elemental structures. Based on a sea angel: Small translucent tapered body, two broad wing-like swimming lobes and a warm glowing internal core; no human limbs or mermaid face. Fantasy adaptation: Opal swimming lobes refract a warm lavender internal glow. Keep the animal body plan readable; no generic cat face, humanoid armour or unrelated dragon anatomy.. Palette: Opal white, lavender, seafoam. Movement: hover / swim with two distinct fin, arm or body pulses.
